note: 16 Euro 96 teams in engine order (EURODEFS.H). In a match team A = setup.team_a, team B = setup.team_b (head, skin, away palette) and setup.team_b_kit (torso, limbs, numbers, kit palette). The Euro 96 front end never writes setup.team_b_kit (see ASSETS.md open issues); use team_b_kit = team_b.
